After this PR opened, whenever 0.11.0 came out (2 Oct). It deprecates a few APIs fenn uses, and ty reported 6 more diagnostics, which turned `pre-commit` red again. Pushed cb70eb0 to clear them, since #326 lists whenever too:

- `PlainDateTime.parse(..., format=)` → `pattern=`, and the `hh` hour specifier → `HH` (dashboard filters, scanner, logging, session ids)
- `Instant.now().to_system_tz()` → `.to_tz(SYSTEM_TZ)`
- `.to_fixed_offset(0)` → `.to_fixed_offset()`, which also gives `+00:00` for an `Instant`

The replacements don't exist in 0.10.x (I checked `pattern=` and `SYSTEM_TZ` on 0.10.3), so `pyproject.toml` now requires `whenever>=0.11.0`.

Locally with whenever 0.11.0: `pre-commit run --all-files` passes (ruff, ruff format, typos, ty), and `pytest -W error::DeprecationWarning` gives 919 passed, 8 skipped.
Hi, #327 clears the `ty` diagnostics that keep `pre-commit` red on #320-#324 (none of them touch those files). Whenever you have time, merging it should unblock the others. Thanks!
